objective: Integrate Azure Face API for facial verification with liveness detection and build biometric template management with encryption.
architecture: AI service layer integrating Azure Cognitive Services Face API, biometric template encryption/decryption, and facial verification workflows with consent tracking.

techStack.choice: Azure Face API (part of Azure Cognitive Services)
techStack.rationale: Azure Face API provides enterprise-grade face verification with Liveness detection to prevent spoofing. Microsoft's compliance certifications cover biometric data processing across multiple jurisdictions. Alternative: AWS Rekognition lacks dedicated liveness detection features critical for attendance fraud prevention. Limitation: Azure Face API costs scale linearly with verification attempts, requiring budget monitoring.

plan.description: Integrate with Azure Face API for face detection and verification
Build biometric template encryption and storage

securityDesign: Encrypt all biometric templates before storage
Implement consent verification before facial verification
Automatic deletion of verification images from S3
Compliance with BIPA, GDPR Article 9 requirements
Audit logging of all facial verification attempts
dependencies: AWS S3 storage from DevOps team
